notes: 123-page May 2025 card for Claude Opus 4 and Claude Sonnet 4. Many CBRN thresholds/results are redacted (figures only); VCT/LAB-Bench/DNA-evasion/cyber-harness figures lack readable numbers and were skipped. Novel compiler has both 50.00% (detailed) and 52.96% (summary) for Sonnet 4 basic tests—both recorded. ASL-3 vs ASL-2 risk decisions apply to different models (Opus vs Sonnet). Apollo Research tested an early snapshot, not the final release. Stderr values taken from ± intervals in tables. Capability marketing benchmarks (e.g. public SWE-bench full set) are not in this safety-focused card beyond RSP hard-subset numbers.
